# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 13 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 13
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us go further and ask: which people is the heir — this one or the earlier one? And to whom does the covenant belong — to us or to them?
2. Hear what scripture says about the people: "Isaac prayed on behalf of his wife Rebecca, because she was childless, and she conceived. Then Rebecca went to inquire of the Lord, and the Lord told her: 'Two nations are in your womb, two peoples in your belly. One people will dominate the other — and the greater will serve the lesser.'"
3. You need to understand: who does Isaac represent? Who does Rebecca represent? And of which people has God shown that it is greater than the other?
4. And in another prophecy, Jacob speaks even more directly to his son Joseph: "Look — God has not taken your face from me. Bring your sons to me so I can bless them."
5. Joseph brought Ephraim and Manasseh, expecting the firstborn Manasseh to receive the blessing. So he positioned Manasseh at Jacob's right hand. But Jacob saw in the Spirit a type of the people who were coming later — and what did he do? He crossed his arms, placing his right hand on the head of Ephraim, the second-born, the younger one — and blessed him. Joseph objected: "Father, move your right hand to Manasseh's head — he is my firstborn." Jacob answered: "I know, my son, I know. But the greater will serve the lesser — and this one will be blessed too."
6. Do you see for whom God appointed that this people would be first — the heir of the covenant?
7. If this was already embedded in God's plan from the very beginning — through Abraham — then we are the people of the inheritance. We are the truly first people.
